import csv
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, PatternFill, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('/home/claude/agent-case/sales.csv')))

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()

# --- Raw Data sheet ---
ws_raw = wb.active
ws_raw.title = "Raw Data"
headers = ["date", "product", "qty", "unit_price", "total"]
ws_raw.append(headers)
for cell in ws_raw[1]:
    cell.font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="4472C4")
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for r in rows:
    qty = int(r['qty']) if r['qty'] != '' else None
    total = float(r['total']) if r['total'] != '' else None
    ws_raw.append([r['date'], r['product'], qty, float(r['unit_price']), total])

n_rows = len(rows)
last_row = n_rows + 1  # +1 for header

for col, width in zip("ABCDE", [12, 18, 8, 12, 12]):
    ws_raw.column_dimensions[col].width = width
for row in ws_raw.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=last_row, min_col=1, max_col=5):
    for cell in row:
        cell.font = Font(name="Arial")
        if cell.column_letter in ("D", "E") and cell.value is not None:
            cell.number_format = '#,##0'

# Highlight the missing-data row
for row in ws_raw.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=last_row, min_col=1, max_col=5):
    if row[2].value is None or row[4].value is None:
        for cell in row:
            cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF2CC")

ws_raw.freeze_panes = "A2"

# --- Summary by Product sheet ---
ws = wb.create_sheet("Summary by Product")
products = sorted(set(r['product'] for r in rows))

title_font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True, size=14)
ws["A1"] = "July 2026 Sales Summary by Product"
ws["A1"].font = title_font
ws["A2"] = "Prices in Thai Baht (THB)"
ws["A2"].font = Font(name="Arial", italic=True, size=10, color="666666")

header_row = 4
cols = ["Product", "Units Sold", "Total Revenue (THB)", "Avg. Unit Price (THB)", "No. of Orders", "% of Total Revenue"]
for i, h in enumerate(cols, start=1):
    c = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=i, value=h)
    c.font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="4472C4")
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", wrap_text=True)

data_start = header_row + 1
for i, p in enumerate(products):
    r = data_start + i
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=p).font = Font(name="Arial")
    # Units Sold = SUMIFS qty where product matches
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2,
            value=f"=SUMIFS('Raw Data'!C2:C{last_row},'Raw Data'!B2:B{last_row},A{r})")
    # Total Revenue = SUMIFS total
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3,
            value=f"=SUMIFS('Raw Data'!E2:E{last_row},'Raw Data'!B2:B{last_row},A{r})")
    # Avg unit price = revenue / units (guard divide by zero)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4,
            value=f"=IFERROR(C{r}/B{r},0)")
    # No. of orders = COUNTIFS
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5,
            value=f"=COUNTIFS('Raw Data'!B2:B{last_row},A{r})")
    for c in range(2, 6):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).font = Font(name="Arial")

data_end = data_start + len(products) - 1

total_row = data_end + 1
ws.cell(row=total_row, column=1, value="TOTAL").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
ws.cell(row=total_row, column=2, value=f"=SUM(B{data_start}:B{data_end})").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
ws.cell(row=total_row, column=3, value=f"=SUM(C{data_start}:C{data_end})").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
ws.cell(row=total_row, column=4, value=f"=IFERROR(C{total_row}/B{total_row},0)").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
ws.cell(row=total_row, column=5, value=f"=SUM(E{data_start}:E{data_end})").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)

# % of total revenue (for products and total)
for r in range(data_start, total_row + 1):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=6, value=f"=IFERROR(C{r}/$C${total_row},0)")
    ws.cell(row=r, column=6).number_format = '0.0%'
    if r == total_row:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=6).font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
    else:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=6).font = Font(name="Arial")

for r in range(data_start, total_row + 1):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).number_format = '#,##0'
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).number_format = '#,##0.00'

thin = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
border = Border(top=thin, bottom=thin, left=thin, right=thin)
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=header_row, max_row=total_row, min_col=1, max_col=6):
    for cell in row:
        cell.border = border

for col, width in zip("ABCDEF", [18, 12, 20, 20, 14, 18]):
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = width

# Note about missing data
note_row = total_row + 2
ws.cell(row=note_row, column=1,
        value="Note: One Backpack order on 2026-07-05 has no recorded quantity/price and is excluded from totals (see highlighted row in Raw Data tab).")
ws.cell(row=note_row, column=1).font = Font(name="Arial", italic=True, size=9, color="666666")

# Best seller callout using formula (INDEX/MATCH on max revenue)
callout_row = note_row + 2
ws.cell(row=callout_row, column=1, value="Top product by revenue:").font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True)
ws.cell(row=callout_row, column=2,
        value=f"=INDEX(A{data_start}:A{data_end},MATCH(MAX(C{data_start}:C{data_end}),C{data_start}:C{data_end},0))")
ws.cell(row=callout_row, column=2).font = Font(name="Arial", bold=True, color="C00000")

ws.freeze_panes = "A5"

wb.save('/home/claude/agent-case/output/sales_summary.xlsx')
print("saved")
EOF
